cards.title: Forms and labels
cards.code:
<form action="/search" method="get">
  <label for="plant">Find a plant</label>
  <input id="plant" name="q" type="search">
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>
cards.explanation: A labeled search form submitting q in the URL. The /search endpoint is illustrative and needs an application backend.

cards.title: Input types and validation
cards.code:
<label for="email">Email for harvest reminders</label>
<input id="email" name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email">
<label for="beds">Number of beds</label>
<input id="beds" name="beds" type="number" min="1" max="20" value="2">
cards.explanation: Offer email and numeric constraints with associated labels. Place controls in a form to submit and trigger native validation.

cards.title: Selects and multiline text
cards.code:

</select>
<label for="notes">Notes</label>

cards.title: Publish a bilingual right-to-left page
cards.code:
ملاحظات الحديقة

Next harvest: Friday

cards.explanation: Complete UTF-8 document. lang selects language, dir selects direction and bdi isolates user-provided text; metadata descriptions do not render in the body.

cards.title: Resolve guide links against a shared base
cards.code: Beans Help
cards.explanation: Serve on HTTP. The first base href changes relative URL resolution, including fragment links; root-relative /help still uses the origin. Keep base in head before URL-bearing elements.
keywords: resolve guide links against a shared base

cards.title: Read parsed controls with a deferred classic script
cards.code:
<script defer src="./deferred.js"></script>
<button id="deferred-action" type="button">Mark ready</button>
<output id="deferred-status">Waiting</output>
cards.explanation: Supply deferred.js: attach a click listener to #deferred-action that sets #deferred-status.textContent to Ready. Defer waits for parsing and preserves classic-script order. Playground supplies that exact local dependency.
keywords: read parsed controls with a deferred classic script

cards.title: Report a failed module import and recover
cards.code: Loading tools
cards.explanation: Serve over HTTP. Supply optional-tools.js exporting label for success, or omit it to exercise fallback. Modules are strict and deferred; async scripts instead run when fetched with no order guarantee.
keywords: report a failed module import and recover

cards.title: Name a regional forecast section
cards.code:
Garden forecast

Weekly forecast

Dry until Friday.

Water restrictions

Check local rules.
cards.explanation: A named section exposes a region; aside is related content. Keep one visible main. Heading levels express hierarchy; section does not automatically reset heading levels.

cards.title: Distinguish multiple navigation landmarks
cards.code:
Home

Bean guide

Planting diary

First shoots appeared today.

Next: peas
cards.explanation: Use distinct names for navigation regions with different purposes. Article is a self-contained diary entry; links need local routes to navigate.

cards.title: Expose machine-readable harvest values
cards.code:
Harvest Friday at 9 am Perth time.

Order Climbing beans.
cards.explanation: datetime includes an explicit offset; data preserves a machine identifier without changing visible wording. Neither element formats dates or submits a form.

cards.title: Attribute a quotation without fake citation links
cards.code: Robin called it a patient experiment.
cards.explanation: cite on blockquote records a source URL but creates no link. The cite element names a work, not a person. q adds quotation punctuation according to browser/language styling.
keywords: attribute a quotation without fake citation links

cards.title: Associate grouped harvest table headers
cards.code:
Harvest by season and crop
CropSpring
Weight (kg)Beds
Beans82
cards.explanation: Explicit headers IDs connect cells through both header levels. IDs must be unique and refer to th elements in the same table. Use a simpler scoped table when grouping is unnecessary.

cards.title: Keep an empty inventory table understandable
cards.code:
Seed inventory
CropPackets
No seed packets recorded.

0 crops in inventory.
cards.explanation: An explicit empty-state row spans the two real columns; preserve the caption and headers. Application code can replace tbody and update status after data arrives.
keywords: keep an empty inventory table understandable

cards.title: Group mutually exclusive delivery choices
cards.code:
<form><fieldset><legend>Delivery speed</legend>
<label><input type="radio" name="speed" value="standard" checked>Standard</label>
<label><input type="radio" name="speed" value="express">Express</label>
</fieldset></form>
cards.explanation: Nested labels associate each radio; a shared name makes choices exclusive. The legend names the group. FormData includes only the checked value.

cards.title: Suggest crops while permitting custom names
cards.code:
<form><label for="crop">Crop name</label><input id="crop" name="crop" list="crops">
<datalist id="crops"><option value="Beans"><option value="Peas"></datalist>
<label for="season">Season</label><select id="season" name="season" required>
<option value="">Choose a season</option><option value="spring">Spring</option><option value="autumn">Autumn</option></select></form>
cards.explanation: Datalist is optional suggestions, so Kale is valid. Select constrains values and rejects the empty placeholder when required. Browser suggestion UI varies; labels remain essential.
keywords: suggest crops while permitting custom names

cards.title: Keep postal codes as text with autofill hints
cards.code: Enter four digits, including a leading zero.
cards.explanation: This application assumes a four-digit postal code. Text retains 0123; numeric inputmode is only a keyboard hint. Pattern supplies the constraint and must be adapted for other countries.
keywords: keep postal codes as text with autofill hints

cards.title: Validate a six-digit verification code
cards.code: Six digits from your local test code.
cards.explanation: Use a disposable local code; no authentication service is contacted. Leading zeros survive. Autofill and virtual keyboards require supported devices and user consent; these hints grant no security.

cards.title: Submit a fixed account key without allowing edits
cards.code:
<form><label for="account">Account key</label><input id="account" name="account" value="BED-07" readonly required>
<label for="internal">Internal note</label><input id="internal" name="internal" value="Not submitted" disabled></form>
cards.explanation: Readonly remains focusable and is submitted; disabled is omitted and cannot receive focus. Clients can alter either attribute, so verify account authorization on the server.
keywords: submit a fixed account key without allowing edits

cards.title: Disable a shipping address until needed
cards.code:
<form><fieldset id="shipping" disabled><legend><label><input id="deliver" type="checkbox" name="deliver">Deliver seeds</label></legend>
<label for="street">Street</label><input id="street" name="street" value="7 Garden Lane" required></fieldset></form>
<script>document.querySelector('#deliver').addEventListener('change', e => {
  document.querySelector('#shipping').disabled = !e.target.checked;
});</script>
cards.explanation: The first legend control remains usable inside a disabled fieldset. Toggling enables required address validation and serialization; a disabled empty street does not block the form.
keywords: disable a shipping address until needed

cards.title: Upload one required profile image
cards.code:
<form action="/upload" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
<label for="avatar">Profile image</label><input id="avatar" name="avatar" type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg" required>
<button>Upload image</button></form>
cards.explanation: A local test endpoint receives multipart bytes. accept is a chooser hint, so the server must inspect actual content and size. Never treat a client MIME type as proof.

cards.title: Send several notes with a multipart description
cards.code:
<form action="/upload" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
<label for="notes">Garden notes</label><input id="notes" name="notes" type="file" accept=".txt" multiple required>
<label for="description">Description</label><input id="description" name="description" value="October notes">
<button>Upload notes</button></form>
cards.explanation: multiple generates repeated parts under the same name. Empty required selection blocks submission. The fixture endpoint rejects disallowed files and allows retry without any persistent storage.
keywords: send several notes with a multipart description

cards.title: Explain an invalid bed code and clear feedback
cards.code: Two capitals, a dash and two digits, for example AB-07.
cards.explanation: Native validation blocks submit before the submit handler. Invalid feedback names the constraint; editing clears stale feedback. This local check does not establish server acceptance.
keywords: explain an invalid bed code and clear feedback

cards.title: Reject an unavailable crop name then recover
cards.explanation: A local reserved-name rule demonstrates setCustomValidity. The input listener must clear the message after correction. Availability on a real server can change; revalidate there.
keywords: reject an unavailable crop name then recover

cards.title: Confirm an action and restore invoking focus
cards.code:
Record harvest?

No decision
cards.explanation: Modern native dialog; method=dialog produces a returnValue rather than sending a request. Cancel is the initial focus. Escape cancels and the close handler returns focus. No data is persisted.
keywords: confirm an action and restore invoking focus

cards.title: Validate an edit inside a modal before closing
cards.code:
Bed label

Unchanged
cards.explanation: Save respects required validation; formnovalidate lets Cancel close even with an empty input. Output uses textContent. Serve as its own page so script bindings remain isolated.
keywords: validate an edit inside a modal before closing

cards.title: Reveal watering help with light dismissal
cards.code:
Watering advice

Check soil moisture first.
cards.explanation: Requires Popover API support. This nonmodal auto popover closes on Escape or an outside click; it does not trap focus. The invoking button supplies the relationship.
keywords: reveal watering help with light dismissal

cards.title: Keep a checklist open until explicitly dismissed
cards.code: Harvest checklist
cards.explanation: A manual popover persists on outside click and Escape. Provide an explicit hide button; users can still interact with the rest of the document. Requires Popover API support.
keywords: keep a checklist open until explicitly dismissed

cards.title: Choose a wider garden illustration on desktop
cards.explanation: Local wide.svg is an alternate composition, not merely a larger encoding. img remains the narrow/unsupported-picture fallback with the accessible name. Use CSS for fluid layout.
keywords: choose a wider garden illustration on desktop

cards.title: Offer correctly sized image candidates
cards.explanation: Supply images with actual 320 and 960 intrinsic widths. sizes is this example’s intended slot hint, not a CSS layout rule; selection may vary with device density and caching. The playground checks fresh contexts at density 1.

cards.title: Play a captioned local field recording
cards.code: Read the recording transcript
cards.explanation: Supply the local short WebM, WebVTT and transcript fixtures. Captions include the visible action and relevant sounds. Missing/undecodable media triggers explicit feedback; fallback children alone do not handle decode failure.
keywords: play a captioned local field recording

cards.title: Offer an audio note with a transcript and error feedback
cards.code: Read the audio transcript
cards.explanation: Supply the local generated silent WAV fixture for controls testing; the transcript identifies it as a silent demonstration. Normal media needs an accurate transcript. No autoplay or external stream.
keywords: offer an audio note with a transcript and error feedback

cards.title: Preview markup with scripts disabled
cards.code: <iframe title="Static garden preview" sandbox srcdoc="<h1>Garden preview</h1><script>document.body.dataset.ran='yes'</script>"></iframe>
cards.explanation: Empty sandbox intentionally blocks the embedded script; heading still renders. The trusted literal is escaped for an HTML attribute. Do not interpolate raw untrusted HTML; sandbox alone does not stop resource requests.

cards.title: Allow a local preview script while isolating its origin
cards.code: Waiting for preview
cards.explanation: Supply frame.html that posts preview-ready to parent after rendering. allow-scripts leaves an opaque origin, so authenticate source and expected message shape; null origin alone is insufficient. Parent DOM access remains denied.
keywords: allow a local preview script while isolating its origin

cards.title: Style a native invalid email with Bootstrap
cards.code: Enter a valid email.
cards.explanation: Load local Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS. Native browser validation stays enabled; was-validated reveals CSS feedback and text is associated with the control. No Bootstrap JS or server is needed. This avoids relying on color alone.
keywords: style a native invalid email with bootstrap

cards.title: Use Bootstrap navigation and native disclosure
cards.code:
OverviewHistory
Seed storage guidance

Keep packets cool and dry.
cards.explanation: Load Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS. aria-current identifies the actual page; active only changes appearance. Native details supplies keyboard disclosure without pretending Bootstrap collapse works without its JS.
keywords: use bootstrap navigation and native disclosure

cards.title: Style semantic validation states with Tailwind
cards.code: Choose 1 to 10 packets.
cards.explanation: Compile the exact classes with Tailwind 4.3.3. Native min/max/required enforce limits; invalid: only styles invalidity. Keep textual instructions and visible focus rather than using color as the sole signal.
keywords: style semantic validation states with tailwind

cards.title: Keep responsive task status and disclosure semantic
cards.code:
Garden tasks

No pending tasks.

Completed tasks
  • Watered beans
cards.explanation: Compile Tailwind 4.3.3 locally. Responsive grid changes layout, while section/headings/status/details preserve meaning. Application code supplies future status updates; no artificial interactive roles are required.
keywords: keep responsive task status and disclosure semantic

cards.title: Load an independent widget asynchronously
cards.code:
<output id="weather">Weather unavailable</output>
<script async src="./async-widget.js"></script>
cards.explanation: Serve over HTTP and supply async-widget.js that sets #weather.textContent to Weather widget ready. The placeholder precedes the script, so it exists even if loading completes immediately. Async does not preserve execution order; keep independent widgets independent. The existing fallback remains when the dependency is missing.
